# Kim Tuyen Truong

> Kim Tuyen Truong (Trương Biện Kim Tuyền) designs and builds websites with SEO and AI search optimization (AIO) for small and mid-size businesses in Vietnam and the United States. Digital Growth Manager at AIxNovate, a U.S. marketing agency. Building websites and doing SEO since 2019.

## Services
- Website design and development (hand-coded PHP/JavaScript or WordPress) with an admin panel for self-editing
- SEO: technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console
- AI search optimization (AIO): FAQ content, schema markup and llms.txt so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews can understand and recommend a business

## Pricing (Vietnam, VND)
- Landing Page: 3.500.000đ
- Website Cơ Bản (standard business website): 9.500.000đ
- Website Doanh Nghiệp (multi-service or e-commerce): from 15.000.000đ
- All packages include first-year hosting and domain, SSL, copywriting, SEO, AIO, Google tools setup, 3-year technical warranty (then 1.500.000đ/year) and 3 social banners.
- Payment in 3 installments: 60% to start, 30% when the site is approved before launch, 10% after handover.

## Results from past projects
- Little World For Kids (Garden Grove, CA): 17,000 users in 6 months, 11,000 from organic search.
- 405 Cabinets & Stone (California): organic traffic grew from 3,500 to 7,800 visits per month in 9 months.
- Nam Mien Trung Group (Vietnam): organic traffic up 500% in 3 months.
